notes.title: Version 0.1.3 Update
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the character was obscured by the taskbar.
Added toggle settings for whether the character's head and hands follow the mouse.

notes.title: Optimize compatibility for window detection
notes.content: Optimized compatibility with more windows, and now characters can also be attached to the steam window.

notes.title: Optimize game compatibility with Wallpaper
notes.content: Optimize the compatibility of the game with Wallpaper.
